title: Dexcom G6 Checking Auth Errors
symptom: With the latest nightly build, error messages appear in the log when trying to receive readings from the G6 transmitter, including 'Could not read after AuthRequestTX' and 'authentication notification throwable: (CHECK_AUTH)'. The system status page shows several error messages (Power connect Errors, Examining Errors, Checking Auth Errors, Scanning Errors) that accumulate every 5 minutes, and it is not possible to receive any readings from the transmitter.
cause: The thread does not definitively establish a root cause. The original reporter and another user speculate that the transmitter may be in a faulty status, as the official Dexcom app also failed to work with it.
fix: The only resolution mentioned is replacing the transmitter, as stated by one user: 'Unfortunately I had to replace the transmitter.' No other fix is provided.
evidence_quote: Unfortunately I had to replace the transmitter. I assume that the transmitter was in a faulty status as the Dexcom G6 app did not work either.
